lines.text: At Beersheba Israel offered sacrifices, and God promised to go down to Egypt with him and make him a great nation.
Jacob's sons carried him to Egypt in the wagons Pharaoh had sent, along with their children, wives, and livestock.
Jacob's family in Egypt numbered seventy, and Reuben had gone ahead to get directions to Goshen, where Joseph met his father.
Joseph chose five brothers to present to Pharaoh, and they said they were shepherds who had come because the famine was severe.
Jacob told Pharaoh his travels had lasted 120 years, and Joseph settled his family in the district of Rameses.
